bullets.text: iOS 26.4 Enhances iCloud Search - iOS 26.4 introduces a search feature for iCloud.com, improving web usability.
Siri Mode Coming to Camera - iOS 27 will feature a new Siri mode in the Camera app for enhanced AI capabilities.
Every iPhone Now Has MagSafe - All new iPhones include MagSafe, a feature absent in Samsung's lineup.
Uber's Sensor Grid Ambition - Uber plans to equip driver cars with sensors to gather data for autonomous vehicle companies.
Philips Hue's SpatialAware Feature - Philips Hue lights now feature SpatialAware for immersive lighting experiences.
New Alarm Feature in iOS 26.4 - iOS 26.4 allows iPhones to sound alarms even when Apple Watch is worn to bed.
Musely Secures $360M Funding - Musely raises $360M in non-dilutive capital to expand its telemedicine platform.
Pentagon Partners with Tech Giants - The Pentagon signs deals with Nvidia, Microsoft, and AWS to deploy AI on classified networks.
Ubuntu Services Hit by DDoS Attack - Ubuntu's infrastructure faces outages due to a DDoS attack by hacktivists.
Musk v. Altman Trial Unfolds - The legal battle between Musk and Altman reveals early communications from OpenAI's inception.
